result.summary: The 2018 values framing (lean global enterprise vision; Quality, Safe, Green, Smart pillars; 'people serving people'; sustainability and community commitments) was replaced by a 2019 'Our belief' and 'Our aspiration' to be 'the world's most trusted company', plus new commitments like 'clean-running cars' and 'designing products centered around the needs of humans'. Emphasis shifts toward trust, mobility and autonomy, with less on sustainability and community service.
